en.headline: Immigration and departments arrest 35 in week-long anti-illegal worker operations
en.dek: Officers searched restaurants, retail shops and renovation sites across the city from 11 to 17 September, detaining suspected illegal workers, employers and overstayers.
body: The Immigration Department, working with the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department, Leisure and Cultural Services Department, Labour Department and police, conducted a series of anti-illegal labour operations across Hong Kong from 11 to 17 September.

Investigators searched restaurants, retail outlets and renovation units. They arrested 22 suspected illegal workers, six employers suspected of hiring them, one person for aiding and abetting, and six overstayers. Among the suspected illegal workers were 11 men and 11 women aged 26 to 55; three of them held recognisance forms that do not allow employment, and one woman was also suspected of using a forged identity card.

The six employers were three men and three women aged 30 to 57. The Immigration Department said investigations into the employers continue and further arrests are not ruled out. Anyone working in breach of stay conditions or employing such persons commits an offence carrying a maximum fine of HK$50,000 and two years’ imprisonment.

zh.headline: 入境處聯同多部門反黑工一周拘35人
zh.dek: 入境處聯同食環署、康文署、勞工處及警方於9月11日至17日在全港多區搜查食肆、零售店及裝修單位，拘捕懷疑非法勞工、僱主及逾期逗留人士。
body: 入境事務處聯同食物環境衞生署、康樂及文化事務署、勞工處及香港警務處，於9月11日至17日在全港多區展開一系列反非法勞工行動。
調查人員搜查餐廳、零售店及裝修單位等地點，共拘捕22名懷疑非法勞工、6名涉嫌聘用非法勞工的僱主、1名協助及教唆者，以及6名逾期逗留人士。被捕的懷疑非法勞工為11男11女，年齡介乎26至55歲，當中兩男一女持有不允許僱傭工作的擔保書，該名女子同時涉嫌行使及管有懷疑偽造身份證。
涉嫌聘用非法勞工的僱主為3男3女，年齡介乎30至57歲。入境處表示，有關僱主的調查仍在進行，不排除有更多人被捕。任何人違反逗留條件或聘用不可合法受僱的人，即屬犯罪，最高可被罰款5萬元及監禁兩年。
